gloss: last-minute rush; rushing in; emergency shelter

definitions.gloss: last-minute rush; rushing in at the last moment
definitions.explanation: doing something hastily just before a deadline, or rushing into a closing door/entrance
a place where people can take refuge in emergencies; also used for shelters for domestic abuse victims

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{駆|か}ける→駆ける：14714_kakeru⟧ (to run) + ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ (to rush into) → rushing in
- ⟦{駆|か}け{込|こ}む→駆け込む：06112_kakekomu⟧ (to rush in)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
Last-minute (sense 1):
- {駆|か}け{込|こ}み⟦{乗車|じょうしゃ}→乗車：06201_jousha⟧ (rushing onto trains - dangerous and discouraged)
- {駆|か}け{込|こ}み⟦{需要|じゅよう}→需要：02616_juyou⟧ (last-minute demand, e.g., before price increases)
- {駆|か}け{込|こ}み⟦{申請|しんせい}→申請：04207_shinsei⟧ (last-minute application)
Refuge (sense 2):
- {駆|か}け{込|こ}み⟦{寺|てら}→寺：01676_tera⟧ (historically a temple where a woman fleeing her marriage could take refuge; now any place of last resort for help)
- {駆|か}け{込|こ}み⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ (place to turn to for help)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Announcements on Japanese trains frequently warn against {駆|か}け{込|こ}み⟦{乗車|じょうしゃ}→乗車：06201_jousha⟧ (rushing onto trains before doors close).

RELATED WORDS:
- {滑|すべ}り⟦{込|こ}み→込み：28615_komi⟧ (slipping in at the last moment)
- ⟦{飛|と}び{込|こ}み→飛び込み：07114_tobikomi⟧ (jumping in unexpectedly)
